mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1)>0 FROM ai_hr_distinct_confirmation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND left_candidate_id=#{left} AND right_candidate_id=#{right} AND left_fact_version=#{leftVersion} AND right_fact_version=#{rightVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_hr_distinct_confirmation(tenant_id,left_candidate_id,right_candidate_id,left_fact_version,right_fact_version,actor_id,reason_json,created_at) VALUES(#{pair.tenant},#{pair.left},#{pair.right},#{pair.leftVersion},#{pair.rightVersion},#{actor},#{reason},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE actor_id=actor_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_hr_distinct_confirmation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (left_candidate_id=#{candidate} OR right_candidate_id=#{candidate})
